planned_production_code_fixes.issue: Mixed-facility restriction logic: evaluate_broker_opportunity previously treated ANY facility having VERIFIED_DIRECT_ONLY as restricting the entire corporate entity.
planned_production_code_fixes.solution: Refactor company evaluation: a company is RESTRICTED only if a company-level DNC/restriction exists or if ALL active/ready operating facilities are VERIFIED_DIRECT_ONLY. When a company has mixed facilities (e.g. Butler is DIRECT_ONLY, Columbia City is broker UNKNOWN), evaluate the company across its actionable, non-restricted facilities so the qualifying non-restricted facility determines the corporate opportunity tier.
planned_production_code_fixes.impact: Steel Dynamics (Company 219) moves from RESTRICTED to TIER_B_WORTH_CALLING. Butler facility remains RESTRICTED individually.

planned_production_code_fixes.issue: Directory tier filtering pushdown divergence: build_company_filter_sql had divergent manual SQL subqueries for tier filtering, causing mismatches (e.g. Engine=99 vs Directory=103).
planned_production_code_fixes.solution: Align build_company_filter_sql to derive company ID filtering directly from the authoritative opportunity classification engine (evaluate_broker_opportunity). Guarantees ENGINE == METADATA == DIRECTORY COUNTS across all 5 tiers and enforces 0 tier overlap.
planned_production_code_fixes.impact: Eliminates all directory tier divergence and ensures complete exclusivity across all filters.
